title: Harbor Trivy Scanner
description: Operational health, performance and capacity of one Harbor Trivy scanner installation. Security findings remain in Harbor.

list.name: datasource
list.label: Data source
list.description: Prometheus source for scanner and supporting infrastructure metrics.

list.name: cluster
list.label: Cluster
list.description: One cluster, identified by its cluster scrape label.

list.name: namespace
list.label: Namespace
list.description: One Harbor namespace within the selected cluster.

list.name: scanner
list.label: Scanner
list.description: Scanner Kubernetes Service; includes all its replicas.

list.name: redis_service
list.label: Redis service (optional)
list.description: Redis exporter Service for the scanner’s Redis server. Leave blank to disable Redis memory.

list.name: loki
list.label: Logs source (optional)
list.description: Loki source with matching cluster, namespace, and pod labels.

list.name: scanner_pods
list.description: Discovered pods of the selected scanner, used to scope Loki queries.

panels.title: Overview
panels.description: Scanner availability, worker activity, and completed work for the selected installation.

panels.title: Reachable replicas
panels.description: Scanner replicas successfully scraped by Prometheus. Fewer than expected: check pod readiness, Service endpoints, and scrape target errors.

panels.title: Instrumented replicas
panels.description: Replicas exposing scanner operational metrics. If reachable replicas are missing here, check their adapter versions and metrics configuration.

panels.title: Active workers
panels.description: Workers currently processing scan tasks, including preparation and report persistence. Check Worker utilization and queue wait to assess remaining capacity.

panels.title: Completed (selected range)
panels.description: Successful adapter task executions in the selected range. Reports containing vulnerabilities count as successful; rescans, retries, and separate tasks count individually.

panels.title: Failed (selected range)
panels.description: Failed adapter task executions in the selected range. Investigate Failure categories and Scanner errors; vulnerability findings do not count as failures.

panels.title: Since last success
panels.description: Time since any replica last completed a task successfully. Investigate if this grows while scans are waiting; growth while idle is normal.

panels.title: Adapter and engine versions
panels.description: Running adapter and Trivy CLI versions per replica. Check for unexpected versions or mixed versions after a rollout.

panels.title: About this dashboard

options.content:
Scanner availability, capacity, and execution health for the selected installation. Runtime includes Trivy subprocesses.

[Metric definitions and empty-panel troubleshooting](https://github.com/container-registry/harbor-scanner-trivy/blob/codex/trivy-metrics-dashboard/deploy/chart/dashboards/README.md).

panels.description: Dashboard scope and links to metric definitions and troubleshooting.

panels.title: Runtime
panels.description: Scanner pod resources and termination state, including Trivy subprocesses. Requires cAdvisor and kube-state-metrics for pod metrics.

panels.title: Pod CPU
panels.description: CPU cores consumed per scanner pod, including Trivy subprocesses and sidecars. Compare with throttling and execution latency when assessing CPU capacity.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,pod,container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",container!="",container!="POD",image!=""}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (cluster,namespace,pod) max by (cluster,namespace,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}))

panels.title: Pod memory and limits
panels.description: Pod memory working set and summed container limits. Near-limit usage warrants checking individual containers for OOM risk; Kubernetes enforces each container limit separately.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,pod,container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",container!="",container!="POD",image!=""})) and on (cluster,namespace,pod) max by (cluster,namespace,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}))

sum by (pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",resource="memory",unit="byte"})) and on (cluster,namespace,pod) max by (cluster,namespace,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}))

panels.title: CPU throttling
panels.description: How often containers hit their CPU limits. High throttling can slow scans; review CPU limits if scan times increase.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,pod,container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",container!="",container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (cluster,namespace,pod) max by (cluster,namespace,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""})) / sum by (pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,pod,container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",container!="",container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (cluster,namespace,pod) max by (cluster,namespace,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}))

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: Container restarts per pod over the selected range. Correlate increases with termination reasons, previous-container logs, and recent deployments.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,pod,container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[$__range]))) and on (cluster,namespace,pod) max by (cluster,namespace,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}))

panels.title: Child peak RSS (p95)
panels.description: p95 peak RSS of completed Trivy subprocesses, grouped by command. Use for memory sizing alongside worker concurrency; simultaneous scans require additional memory.

panels.title: Last container termination was OOM
panels.description: Last recorded container termination state. OOMKilled may predate the selected range; check restart timing and memory limits. Empty without termination history or kube-state-metrics.

targets.expr: max by (pod,container) ((kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",reason="OOMKilled"}) and on (cluster,namespace,pod) max by (cluster,namespace,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}))

panels.title: Scanning and workers
panels.description: Adapter queueing, worker capacity, execution time, and scan failures.

panels.title: Execution throughput
panels.description: Finished adapter task executions per minute, split by outcome. Falling throughput with a growing queue indicates a processing bottleneck.

panels.title: Execution latency (p95)
panels.description: p95 worker execution time, including preparation, Trivy calls, and report persistence. Excludes queueing. Compare with CLI and store latency to locate delays.

panels.title: Adapter queue wait (p95)
panels.description: p95 wait from adapter enqueue to worker lock acquisition. Rising wait with saturated workers indicates capacity pressure; Harbor scheduling delay is measured separately.

panels.title: Worker utilization
panels.description: Busy workers as a share of configured concurrency, per replica. Sustained saturation with rising queue wait warrants reviewing worker capacity and scan duration.

panels.title: Oldest running execution
panels.description: Age of the oldest active task per replica; zero while idle. Investigate tasks exceeding normal execution times. Total task duration can exceed the CLI timeout.

panels.title: Failure categories
panels.description: Execution failures per minute by stage and category. Use categories to narrow log searches; classifications are heuristic. Empty before the first recorded failure.

panels.title: Dispatch outcomes
panels.description: Dispatch decisions per minute. lock_busy usually reflects duplicate delivery; decode_error and lock_error prevent execution and warrant investigating message handling or Redis.

panels.title: Trivy child duration (p95)
panels.description: p95 Trivy subprocess duration by command and outcome. Includes database updates, image access, and analysis; use logs to identify which phase is slow.

panels.title: SBOM reuse and fallback
panels.description: Existing-SBOM lookup, reuse, and image-scan fallback events per minute. Repeated lookup errors or fallbacks warrant checking Harbor accessory access and SBOM compatibility.

panels.title: Publications with no subscribers
panels.description: Job publications per minute with no Redis subscribers. These messages are not retained. Check worker subscriptions and Redis connectivity when nonzero.

panels.title: Child termination reasons
panels.description: Trivy subprocess completions per minute by termination reason. Investigate nonzero_exit, signal, and start_error in logs; a signal alone does not establish OOM.

panels.title: Configured CLI timeout
panels.description: Configured timeout for a Trivy scan invocation; highest value across replicas. Compare with CLI duration when investigating timeouts. Queueing and adapter processing add to total latency.

panels.title: Trivy vulnerability DB and Java index
panels.description: Downloaded vulnerability records and the Java package index, per replica. Local scan-analysis cache usage is shown under Cache and storage.

panels.title: Trivy database content age
panels.description: Age of the downloaded vulnerability DB and Java package index content. If age grows during active scanning, check update policy and download errors.

panels.title: Trivy database availability
panels.description: Local vulnerability DB and Java package index availability. Java index absence can be normal until Java analysis needs it.

panels.title: Next Trivy database update
panels.description: Time until the downloaded vulnerability DB or Java index is eligible for an update. Negative means due; downloads depend on Trivy invocation and update policy.

panels.title: Automatic database updates
panels.description: Whether Trivy may update its vulnerability DB and Java package index. Check when content stays old; offline-scan alone does not disable downloads.

panels.title: Trivy metadata collection
panels.description: Collection health for Trivy version and downloaded database metadata. On failure, check version discovery and metadata-file access.

panels.title: Trivy metadata snapshot age
panels.description: Time since Trivy version and database metadata were successfully collected. Growth beyond the collection interval indicates stale monitoring data.

panels.title: Cache and storage
panels.description: Filesystem capacity and optional local cache sizes. Shared mounts can appear under multiple paths or replicas.

panels.title: Local analysis cache and database sizes
panels.description: Local BoltDB analysis cache, vulnerability DB, and Java index sizes. Requires metrics.collection.cacheSizeEnabled. Missing paths or failed collection omit values; Redis cache memory is excluded.

panels.title: Filesystem utilization
panels.description: Filesystem capacity unavailable to the scanner, including other files and reserved space. High utilization can block database updates and report writes. Do not sum shared mounts.

panels.title: Available filesystem space
panels.description: Filesystem space available at cache and report paths. Sustained decline warrants reviewing cache growth and volume capacity; both paths may share a mount.

panels.title: Available inodes
panels.description: Available filesystem inodes. Exhaustion blocks file creation even with free disk space. Empty where inode accounting is unsupported.

panels.title: Estimated time to full
panels.description: Time to disk exhaustion projected from a six-hour free-space trend. Empty without a declining trend or 60 samples. Reassess after cleanup, resizing, or workload changes.

panels.title: Storage collection status
panels.description: Latest storage collection result. On failure, check permissions, missing paths, and collection limits. Cache-walk metrics are absent when disabled.

panels.title: Reports and persistence
panels.description: Report persistence, Harbor result retrieval, and adapter Redis client health.

panels.title: Report size (p95)
panels.description: p95 report payload size before and after compression. Rising sizes increase persistence and retrieval workload. Empty without recent report writes.

panels.title: Compression ratio
panels.description: Raw report bytes divided by compressed bytes for recent writes. Higher means better compression. Empty without recent report writes.

panels.title: Applied payload write rate
panels.description: Confirmed job/report payload bytes written per second, split by encoding. Use to assess persistence traffic; raw and compressed represent the same writes and must not be added.

panels.title: Report fetch outcomes
panels.description: Harbor report polls per minute by result. pending is expected during scanning; investigate persistent error or not_found responses. not_found can indicate expiry or an unknown job ID.

panels.title: Successful report fetch age (p95)
panels.description: p95 delay between task completion and successful report retrieval. Rising delay warrants checking Harbor polling and jobservice health. Empty without recent successful fetches.

panels.title: Effective report retention TTL
panels.description: Configured Redis retention for scan jobs and reports, refreshed by writes. Check when Harbor receives not_found for previously valid jobs.

panels.title: Store operation outcomes
panels.description: Adapter Redis store operations per minute by operation and outcome. Investigate error outcomes; not_found and not_applied indicate missing records or conditional writes that did not apply.

panels.title: Store latency (p95)
panels.description: p95 adapter store-operation latency. Rising latency can delay task completion and report retrieval; check Redis load, connection waits, and network latency.

panels.title: Redis pool connections
panels.description: Redis client pool connections per replica; total includes idle. Assess pool pressure alongside connection waits and timeouts.

panels.title: Redis pool timeouts
panels.description: Redis connection-pool wait timeouts per minute. Nonzero values can interrupt job coordination and persistence; check pool contention and Redis responsiveness.

panels.title: Average pool wait
panels.description: Mean Redis connection wait among requests that waited. Empty when no waits occurred. Rising waits and timeouts indicate connection-pool pressure.

panels.title: Redis server memory (optional)
panels.description: Redis server memory, including other workloads on shared servers. Requires a Redis exporter and a Redis service selection; blank selection disables this panel.

panels.title: API
panels.description: Adapter HTTP request handling and Go heap usage. Scanning runs asynchronously in Trivy subprocesses.

panels.title: API request rate
panels.description: Adapter HTTP requests per minute by route and status, excluding probes and scrapes. Investigate unexpected error responses; report polling can produce many requests per scan.

panels.title: API latency (p95)
panels.description: p95 adapter HTTP response time by route. Rising latency warrants checking report handling and persistence. Scan execution time is measured separately.

panels.title: Adapter Go heap
panels.description: Current Go heap allocation in the adapter process. If pod memory grows while this stays flat, investigate Trivy subprocesses and filesystem cache.

panels.title: Harbor scheduling context (optional)
panels.description: Harbor IMAGE_SCAN scheduling and outcomes for the selected installation, including other registered scanners. Requires Harbor exporter and jobservice metrics.

panels.title: Harbor scan queue size
panels.description: IMAGE_SCAN tasks waiting in Harbor jobservice, across scanner registrations. A growing backlog warrants checking jobservice workers and scanner capacity.

panels.title: Harbor scan queue latency
panels.description: Wait age of the next IMAGE_SCAN task in Harbor’s queue. Rising age with a nonempty queue indicates scheduling delay before adapter processing.

panels.title: Harbor scan job outcomes
panels.description: Processed Harbor IMAGE_SCAN tasks per minute by jobservice status, across scanner registrations. Compare failures with adapter outcomes to distinguish orchestration from execution problems.

panels.title: Logs (optional)
panels.description: Scanner logs from Loki, scoped to pods currently discovered for the selected scanner.

panels.title: Scanner logs
panels.description: Logs from the selected scanner pods. Use to investigate scan progress, database downloads, and failures. Requires matching Loki labels; deleted pods fall out of discovery.

panels.title: Scanner errors
panels.description: Scanner log lines matching error, fatal, or panic. Inspect messages alongside execution failures; keyword matches can include harmless output.
